edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff Seven Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($750,000) (the “Settlement Amount”) within five (5) business days after the Effective Date.
edits.name: Payment revision

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon timely receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases and forever discharges Defendant from all claims that were asserted or could have been asserted in connection with the matters described in the pleadings.
edits.name: Release unchanged

edits.text:
4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is a compromise of disputed claims and is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or responsibility by any party.

5. ENFORCEMENT; LATE PAYMENT. If Defendant fails to timely pay the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff may seek enforcement of this Agreement in a court of competent jurisdiction. In any proceeding to enforce payment, the prevailing party shall be entitled to recover its reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs incurred in connection with such enforcement. Any unpaid portion of the Settlement Amount shall accrue interest from the date payment was due until paid at the maximum rate permitted by applicable law, or if no maximum rate applies, at the statutory judgment rate applicable in the forum court.
edits.name: Add enforcement provision
